note: scripts/seed-ticketing.ts (renamed from the earlier seed-ticket-types.ts draft — it now seeds the ticketType docs, the ticketsPage singleton, AND patches nationalShow.salesOpen, so the name is scoped to the whole feature, not just ticket types). Every string below is REAL intended wording — never blank, never a TODO placeholder. Standing project rule: a secretary opening a blank Studio field reads it as a broken CMS.
ticketTypes: see contracts/golden/ticketing-m1-m2/ticket-type-schema.golden.json for the field shape — the five seeded documents (adult/pensioner/child/saoc-member/exhibitor) are unchanged from the original F1 draft and still created via createIfNotExists, still marked 'Provisional price — pending council confirmation.' in description.

nationalShowPatch.note: salesMessage is NOT seeded here — it does not exist on nationalShow anymore. The copy shown when sales are closed lives on ticketsPage.salesClosedMessage instead (see decision #7 in README.md). nationalShow keeps only the functional salesOpen boolean gate.

ticketsPage.title: Get Your Tickets
ticketsPage.intro: Secure your seat at the SAOC National Show — South Africa's premier orchid exhibition, bringing together growers, judges and orchid lovers from across the country.
ticketsPage.salesClosedMessage: Tickets for the 2027 National Show are not yet on sale — check back soon.
ticketsPage.termsNote: Tickets are non-refundable but may be transferred to another attendee by emailing info@saoc.co.za before the show. Please bring your booking reference to the door.
ticketsPage.confirmationPendingMessage: We're still waiting for payment confirmation from PayFast. This usually takes a few seconds — please don't refresh or submit payment again. This page will update automatically.
ticketsPage.confirmationSuccessMessage: Thank you — your payment is confirmed and your spot at the SAOC National Show is secured.
ticketsPage.confirmationNotFoundMessage: We couldn't find a booking for that reference. If you've just paid, check the confirmation link or contact info@saoc.co.za.
ticketsPage.ticketIncludesNote: Your ticket includes full-day entry to the National Show floor, access to the judging galleries, and entry to all exhibitor stages.
ticketsPage.cancelledMessage: No payment was taken. Your reservation has been left open — you're welcome to try again whenever you're ready.
